findings.evidence: lock a Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window
findings.rationale: Specifies locking the account without defining the lockout duration, unlock mechanism, or error/notification behavior for locked login attempts.

findings.evidence: notify him
findings.rationale: The pronoun 'him' is referentially ambiguous among the Librarian, the Member, and the Guarantor, and assumes a male recipient.

findings.evidence: TBD minutes
findings.rationale: Uses an unresolved 'TBD' placeholder for the password-reset token expiration time.

findings.evidence: user-friendly Member dashboard that is easy to navigate and loads rapidly on standard connections
findings.rationale: Relies on subjective, unmeasurable terms ('user-friendly', 'easy to navigate', 'loads rapidly', 'standard connections') without objective acceptance criteria.

findings.evidence: TBD consecutive times
findings.rationale: Uses an unresolved 'TBD' placeholder for the maximum number of consecutive loan renewals.

findings.evidence: validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and issue the loan receipt
findings.rationale: Defines only the success path and omits system behavior and error handling when item eligibility validation fails.

findings.evidence: the allowed maximum number of active hold requests
findings.rationale: References an 'allowed maximum number' of active hold requests without specifying any numeric limit in the SRS.

findings.evidence: up to 8 physical items simultaneously
findings.rationale: Allows a Member in good standing to borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously, conflicting with SD-009 which caps simultaneous checkouts at 5.

findings.evidence: 21 calendar days
findings.rationale: Sets the standard loan period for circulating print books to 21 calendar days, conflicting with SD-010 which sets it to 14 calendar days.

findings.evidence: self-register online with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification
findings.rationale: Permits unverified self-registration and immediate checkout with only an email address, contradicting SD-001 which requires Librarian verification of government-issued photo ID and full contact details.

findings.evidence: remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold
findings.rationale: Requires reserved items to be held indefinitely until explicit cancellation, contradicting SD-011 which expires and cancels uncollected holds after 72 hours.

findings.evidence: send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag
findings.rationale: Uses chained 'and/or' connectors, leaving unclear which subset or combination of the three actions must be executed.

findings.evidence: shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded
findings.rationale: Uses passive voice without identifying which role or service reviews, approves, and records overdue fine waiver requests.

findings.evidence: before the due date if appropriate
findings.rationale: Uses the subjective qualifier 'if appropriate' without defining the criteria for sending SMS alerts, alongside an unspecified lead time before the due date.

findings.evidence: TBD years
findings.rationale: Uses an unresolved 'TBD' placeholder for the payment receipt retention period.

findings.evidence: $1.25 USD per overdue day per item with no maximum cap
findings.rationale: Specifies an overdue fine of $1.25 USD/day with no cap, conflicting with SD-019 which specifies $0.50 USD/day capped at $20.00 USD per item.

findings.evidence: permitted to renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance
findings.rationale: Allows renewals regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance, contradicting SD-020 which blocks borrowing and renewing when unpaid fines exceed $5.00 USD.

findings.evidence: Patron's active loan count and enforce the 5-item borrowing limit on the Patron profile screen
findings.rationale: Introduces the inconsistent term 'Patron' instead of 'Member' used across earlier requirements (such as SD-009 and SD-015), and references the 5-item limit from SD-009 which conflicts with SD-015's 8-item limit.

findings.evidence: quickly even when many users
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified terms ('quickly', 'many users') with no measurable latency target or concurrency threshold.

findings.evidence: where possible
findings.rationale: Uses the weak, non-verifiable phrase 'where possible' without defining when highlighting is required versus optional.

findings.evidence: sufficient ISBN matching accuracy and acceptable response times
findings.rationale: Uses subjective terms ('sufficient', 'acceptable') without specifying concrete accuracy percentages or response-time thresholds.

findings.evidence: efficiently process large batch MARC21 files without noticeable system slowdown
findings.rationale: Uses vague terms ('efficiently', 'large', 'noticeable system slowdown') without quantifiable file sizes, throughput, or degradation limits.

findings.evidence: shall detect the active references
findings.rationale: Specifies detecting active loans or holds on deletion attempts, but omits the resulting system action (such as blocking deletion and returning an error).

findings.evidence: TBD intervals
findings.rationale: Uses an unresolved 'TBD' placeholder for the database backup schedule interval.

findings.evidence: important administrative actions in a timely manner and retain them for an appropriate period
findings.rationale: Uses unmeasurable terms ('important', 'in a timely manner', 'appropriate period') without enumerating audited actions, timing bounds, or retention duration.

findings.evidence: shall log event FAILOVER-01
findings.rationale: Specifies only logging FAILOVER-01 when the primary database is unreachable for over 10 seconds, omitting the failover/recovery action or operator alert.

findings.evidence: adequate transport security and clear error messages
findings.rationale: Uses vague terms ('adequate', 'clear') without specifying required transport protocols/ciphers or error message standards.

findings.evidence: accept any Member password of at least 8 characters
findings.rationale: Accepts any password of at least 8 characters, conflicting with SD-002 which requires at least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and numeric characters.

findings.evidence: active for 60 minutes of user inactivity
findings.rationale: Keeps web portal sessions active for 60 minutes of inactivity, conflicting with SD-004 which terminates sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity.

findings.evidence: encrypt all Member passwords using reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt and retrieve forgotten passwords
findings.rationale: Requires reversible AES-256 encryption so plaintext passwords can be retrieved, contradicting SD-003 which mandates one-way bcrypt hashing and forbids storing plaintext passwords.
